records.title: Code as Worlds: Agentic Discovery of Executable World Representations for Physical Reasoning
records.reason: Agentic executable-world representations target physical reasoning capability, not inference resource reduction.

records.title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer
records.reason: Fully Looped Transformer stabilizes training for recurrent LMs and permits varying loop count at test time. Results show language-model task gains, but loops deliberately add inference computation; the text does not demonstrate lower latency or serving cost at matched quality.

records.title: Does This Button Work? Investigating YouTube's Ineffective User Controls
records.reason: Investigates YouTube user controls; unrelated to model inference.

records.title: The Illusion of Stochasticity in LLMs
records.reason: Studies failures of stochastic sampling behavior in LLM agents, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Memory Intelligence Agent
records.reason: MIA stores compressed research-agent workflows and uses a planner/executor plus test-time planner updates. The body describes memory retrieval and multi-agent training/inference pipelines, but does not quantify net inference cost savings; extra agents and update work make serving impact unresolved.
